audiences.executive: Backups and records that must not change kept safe from deletion, at low cost, in the country you choose.
audiences.technical: S3-compatible buckets with object lock, replication, tenants and encryption keys under your control.
audiences.financial: Cheaper per terabyte than block or file for backups and archives, with no charge for reading back data kept on premises.

people: Application teams that write to S3

objections.says: We will just use a public cloud bucket.
objections.clarify: How much is read back each month, and must the data stay in the country?
objections.answer: Compare the total, including reads and transfer out, and where the data must live.
objections.prove: Model the monthly cost of the test dataset, read-back included, here and in a public bucket.

objections.says: On premises, an administrator can always delete.
objections.clarify: Who can delete today, and what would an auditor accept as proof?
objections.answer: Use a retention lock that no account can lift before it expires, and show it.
objections.prove: Try to delete a locked object with the most powerful administrator account.

objections.says: Our backup software may not support it.
objections.clarify: Which product and version, and which features: lock, tiering?
objections.answer: Check the compatibility of the exact versions in use, and test them.
objections.prove: Run a backup and a restore with the customer's own backup software against a locked bucket.
